parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main enclosure that houses the internal components and door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, protects internal mechanisms, and contains the washing chamber where dishes are cleaned.
parts.Movement_description: The body itself is stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: The base of the dishwasher is a stainless steel platform that supports the entire structure and houses some mechanical and drainage components.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the dishwasher, supports the weight of the internal components, and provides a foundation for plumbing and electrical connections.
parts.Movement_description: The base remains fixed and does not move during operation.
